name: turn-end
description: The single blocking Stop hook. Plugins ship turn-end DUTIES instead of their own hooks; the runner checks each against real state and emits one consolidated message per user request. Replaces the mutually re-arming blocking hooks that fired eight times over one request. 0.9.0: TRACE SCHEMA v1 — the fire, every supply duty (engine / ms / cost / judge vs ranker picks) and a per-span acted-on derivation each leave their own line in the cross-plugin contract; hint-followed % is computable from disk. 0.15.0: a request is one message from the owner (helper wakes never re-arm a duty or stand in for his words); self-check judges what actually ran; the reviewer runs per message that changed something; test-integrity + locked-tests show every test change. 0.16.0: the reviewer is also handed HIS STANDING RULES — every "(his words)" section of his personal instructions, with the facts the record has (tests first; a logic map written before the code).
